soldier: Head brownish yellow, mandibles reddish brown, pilosity of the head capsule sparse. Head capsule rectangular, head-width index about 0.57, lateral margins nearly parallel, the posterior half slightly narrowed, posterior margin broad and rounded. Frontal peaks distinctly raised. Antennae broken off; the scale covering the antennal socket upturned, forming a short lid. Labrum broadly ligulate, broad and rounded at the apex, with apical and subapical setae, the lateral apical setae reduced and minute. Mandibles stout, apex rather curved, with the mandibular basal ridge; length about 0.52 times head capsule length and about 0.92 times head width. Waist region of the postmentum narrow and elongate, waist constriction index 0.35, postmentum 9.5 times as long as the waist constriction. Pronotum about 1.55 times as wide as long, anterior margin nearly straight with a distinct incision in the middle, the posterior lateral corners together with the posterior margin forming a broad arc, the posterior margin also incised in the middle; setae in the middle region abundant and dense.
taxonomy_note: The genus name is printed as Reticuliter mes in the original work, a misspelling of Reticulitermes; the species is here placed in Reticulitermes.
